KEN.note: PesaLink is bank-owned and no CBK oversight in service is stated; the CBK fast payment working group and the draft National Payment System Bill are not in service.
No rule in force or redress body stated; the draft Bill is described only as proposed.
No government payment to people stated.
Only PesaLink user and M-PESA agent counts, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: Fintech Association of Kenya cites Safaricom reporting almost 299,000 M-PESA agents and roughly 676,000 active Lipa na M-PESA merchants in the year to March 2025.

Fintech Association of Kenya reports that in October 2024 the CBK said banks, mobile-money companies and payment providers had achieved substantial interoperability, though partly through bilateral connections.
